description: Self-test for narration across a clickNewPage boundary: one line is spoken on the first tab (where three steps share it) and again as the first line of the second tab, which has its own recording, its own .vtt and its own cue. A memo keyed on the line alone gives that second-tab cue no beat at all, so the words are cut off and the next screen lands on top of them; the memo has to be per recording.

steps.caption: Same words.

steps.caption: Same words.

steps.name: the second tab is on screen
steps.caption: Same words.
